catalog_small_index_checks.whole_25_check_provenance: Root original prepare execution; reviewer reran only the selected 7,835,686-byte original transport control.

scope: Transport byte preservation and restore safety for the frozen scripts; not new native execution, benchmark acceptance or published-tree completeness.
static_findings: prepare reads each selected original without extracting it, checks official whole ZIP size and SHA256, checks inode/mtime/size stability, and partitions the exact stream into ordered 2 MiB chunks with SHA256 and Git blob SHA1.
prepare uses exclusive creation of its manifests/catalog/private plan; public per-artifact metadata retains original source/run/acceptance scope and planned publication boundary.
restore requires expected schema and whole SHA, contiguous ordered chunks, positive sizes, relative chunks paths without traversal, and resolved regular files inside the chunks directory.
restore hashes the actual copied bytes against each chunk size/SHA256/GitOID and then the whole original ZIP; it does not unpack or reserialize ZIP members.

restore refuses preexisting output (including dangling symlink); exclusive partial creation does not truncate an existing partial; final os.link is non-overwriting even if output appears after the initial existence check; failed owned partial is removed.
The bytes/mode checks concern custody files and exact ZIP content. This is not a claim that restoration preserves the original filesystem inode, timestamp or mode of the ZIP file.

No network, token handling, benchmark invocation, archive extraction or Cargo execution exists in restore. This review assumes the selected fixed verified custody tree is not concurrently rewritten by another writer.
